THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
099
STUDY 063
Lilac Ribbed Top & Patterned Trousers
Rights check
Source: 24415.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, sleek brown hair
pulled back holds a patterned mug while seated
cross-legged on a sage floral sofa. She wears a
lavender ribbed turtleneck, layered silver chains, and
gold hoop earrings. Her patterned purple-and-brown
knit trousers and chunky pale sneakers complete the
look. Soft morning light from a sheer curtain. Palette of
lilac, sage, and warm gold. Cozy and nostalgic, in the
style of a 1990s film still.
Cozy, nostalgic, eclectic
WORKING NOTES
- The layered chains and patterned trousers are the
signature styling.
- Use 'soft film grain' for a vintage feel.
Try this: Add soft film grain.
